decision.reason: [ev-a7987ba26c2f] is a single changelog line. It names the subject as the code package `internal/xresource` and says the code moved back to `pkg/resource` in crossplane-runtime. It does not say who is exposed (applicability) or what happens to anyone who does nothing (consequence), and for those details it only points to PR #6553. Deciding whether this has any operator-facing effect or is a purely internal refactor would need the PR or similar evidence. The release line alone does not say which it is.
